domain.description: One domain, for example example.com. URL prefixes, paths, ports and a trailing dot are removed; subdomains are preserved. At most 2048 input characters and 253 characters after normalization.

apis.description: Query domain registration and expiration dates and domain age synchronously. Supply one domain; URL prefixes, paths, ports and a trailing dot are removed as with Domain Rating. Subdomains are preserved. age_days is the number of complete elapsed 24-hour periods between a valid registration timestamp and as_of (UTC). Missing, invalid or future registration dates yield age_days=null and cost no credits; a valid age of zero is billable. Missing expiration does not affect billing. Dates and empty business values are preserved. This measures the current registration record, not website launch time or complete registration history. No task ID or polling is required. With the current configuration, each successful request costs 1 credit.

Returns template IDs as strings, titles, covers, preview videos, usage estimates and historical positions. Duplicates and order are preserved; page size varies. Snapshots retained for 30 days. Non-empty successful pages use the configured rate; empty lists and failures are not charged. With the current configuration, each successful request costs 2 credits.

Returns day in YYYYMMDD (Asia/Shanghai capture date), items with the same fields as the historical endpoint, creditsUsed and remainingCredits. No fallback to historical results on failure. Returns day and the available items for that date, including name, description, category, domain, pricingText, releasedAt and links. No pagination. Non-empty successful results use the configured credit rate; empty lists and failures are not charged. With the current configuration, each successful request costs 5 credits.

day.description: Optional YYYYMMDD date in Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8). Omit for today. Accepts the latest 30 calendar days including today (20261016–20261114); future dates are rejected. Returns all items for that date; no pagination.

apis.description: Search Google Scholar articles with query, find citing articles with cites (optionally narrowed by query), or find article versions with cluster. cluster cannot be combined with query or cites. Page starts at 1; page and start are mutually exclusive. scisbd: 0 relevance, 1 recent abstracts, 2 recent articles. Year bounds are inclusive and as_ylo must not exceed as_yhi. JSON results preserve missing and empty fields. Nonempty successful pages are billed independently; empty results and failures are not billed. Read decimal cites IDs from cited_by_url and cluster IDs from versions_url; result.id is not a substitute. Author profiles and citation-format export are outside this tool. With the current configuration, each successful request costs 1 credit.

query.description: Search query; at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

setlang.description: Interface-language hint, not a result-language filter; Bing may fall back to English.

coordinates.description: Location bias, not a geographic boundary. Mutually exclusive with location. In GET requests serialize this object as JSON.

safe.description: Safe search: active enables strict filtering; off requests unfiltered results.

filters.description: Native Bing URL filters; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters. Mutually exclusive with tbs; preserve exactly when paginating.

startDay.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD format. Required for: advertiserStatistics, domainStatistics, titleSearch, googleAdsTitleSearch, domainTitles, hostTitleSearch, domainImageAds, domainTitleCountries, domainTitleImageAds.

endDay.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD format. Required for: advertiserStatistics, domainStatistics, titleSearch, googleAdsTitleSearch, domainTitles, hostTitleSearch, domainImageAds, domainTitleCountries, domainTitleImageAds.

page.description: Zero-based result page. Optional for: titleSearch, googleAdsTitleSearch, hostTitleSearch.

size.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100. titleSearch and googleAdsTitleSearch default to 10; other paginated actions retain their documented defaults. Optional for: titleSearch, googleAdsTitleSearch, hostTitleSearch.

inputSchema.description: Select one action and provide every parameter required by that action.

oneOf.description: Query weekly advertiser statistics. First call advertiserSearch, then pass an exact data.result[].id value as advertiserId.

Query image ads under a domain. First call domainSearch, then pass an exact data.result[].id value as hostId.

Query country distribution for one domain title ad. First call domainTitles and pass the same data.result[] item's hostId and exact title; alternatively call hostTitleSearch and use one data.result.items[] item's hostId and exact title.
